====================================================================================================
Rules that every cast follows

Each section shows one rule with a few cases. The rules that hold for every pair of types are also
checked over all sample types by `test_cast_invariants`, without a golden file.
====================================================================================================


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Casts without an implementation

A cast without an implementation fails type checking, instead of failing on every row.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(1.5 AS DATE)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `Decimal(2, 1)` to type `Date`



error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | TRY_CAST(to_binary('ab') AS INT32)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `Binary` to type `Int32`



error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(to_interval('1 day') AS INT64)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `Interval` to type `Int64`



error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | TRY_CAST(parse_json('1') AS BITMAP)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `Variant` to type `Bitmap`



----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRY_CAST fails by row

`TRY_CAST` turns a row that fails into NULL and converts the other rows.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : TRY_CAST(s AS INT32)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(s::String AS Int32)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>(s AS Int32 NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+----------------+-------------------------------------+
|        | s              | Output                              |
+--------+----------------+-------------------------------------+
| Type   | String         | Int32 NULL                          |
| Domain | {"-1"..="abc"} | {-2147483648..=2147483647} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | '1'            | 1                                   |
| Row 1  | 'abc'          | NULL                                |
| Row 2  | '2147483648'   | NULL                                |
| Row 3  | '-1'           | -1                                  |
+--------+----------------+-------------------------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                    |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[1, abc, 2147483648, -1])                            |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Int32([1, 0, 0, -1]), validity: [0b____1001] } |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(s AS UINT8)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(s::String AS UInt8)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>(s AS UInt8 NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+----------------+--------------------+
|        | s              | Output             |
+--------+----------------+--------------------+
| Type   | String         | UInt8 NULL         |
| Domain | {"-1"..="abc"} | {0..=255} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | '1'            | 1                  |
| Row 1  | 'abc'          | NULL               |
| Row 2  | '2147483648'   | NULL               |
| Row 3  | '-1'           | NULL               |
+--------+----------------+--------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                   |
+--------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[1, abc, 2147483648, -1])                           |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: UInt8([1, 0, 0, 0]), validity: [0b____0001] } |
+--------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(s AS DATE)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(s::String AS Date)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>(s AS Date NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+----------------------------+------------------------------+
|        | s                          | Output                       |
+--------+----------------------------+------------------------------+
| Type   | String                     | Date NULL                    |
| Domain | {"2000-01-01"..="invalid"} | {-719162..=2932896} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | '2000-01-01'               | '2000-01-01'                 |
| Row 1  | 'invalid'                  | NULL                         |

evaluation (internal):

| Column | Data                                                                |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[2000-01-01, invalid])                           |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Date([10957, 0]), validity: [0b______01] } |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(s AS DATE) IS NULL
raw expr       : not(is_not_null(TRY_CAST(s::String AS Date)))
checked expr   : not<Boolean>(is_not_null<T0=Date><T0 NULL>(TRY_CAST<String>(s AS Date NULL)))
evaluation:
+--------+----------------------------+---------------+
|        | s                          | Output        |
+--------+----------------------------+---------------+
| Type   | String                     | Boolean       |
| Domain | {"2000-01-01"..="invalid"} | {FALSE, TRUE} |
| Row 0  | '2000-01-01'               | false         |
| Row 1  | 'invalid'                  | true          |
+--------+----------------------------+---------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+-------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                      |
+--------+-------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[2000-01-01, invalid]) |
| Output | Boolean([0b______10])                     |
+--------+-------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(s AS TIMESTAMP)

+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(parse_json(s) AS INT32)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(parse_json(s::String) AS Int32)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Variant>(CAST<String>(s AS Variant) AS Int32 NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+--------------------+------------+
|        | s                  | Output     |
+--------+--------------------+------------+
| Type   | String             | Int32 NULL |
| Domain | {"\"a\""..="null"} | Unknown    |
| Row 0  | '1'                | 1          |
| Row 1  | '"a"'              | NULL       |
| Row 2  | 'null'             | NULL       |
| Row 3  | '1.5'              | 2          |
| Row 4  | '[1]'              | NULL       |
+--------+--------------------+------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                      |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[1, "a", null, 1.5, [1]])                              |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Int32([1, 0, 0, 2, 0]), validity: [0b___01001] } |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRY_CAST converts like CAST

`TRY_CAST` converts a value as `CAST` does, and only differs on the rows that fail.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST(CAST(s AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS STRING)
raw expr       : CAST(CAST(s::String AS Decimal(38, 9)) AS String)
checked expr   : CAST<Decimal(38, 9)>(CAST<String>(s AS Decimal(38, 9)) AS String)
evaluation:
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
|        | s                                                   | Output                           |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| Type   | String                                              | String                           |
| Domain | {"-0.000000001"..="12345678901234567890.123456789"} | Unknown                          |
| Row 0  | '1.1'                                               | '1.100000000'                    |
| Row 1  | '-0.000000001'                                      | '-0.000000001'                   |
| Row 2  | '12345678901234567890.123456789'                    | '12345678901234567890.123456789' |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                    |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[1.1, -0.000000001, 12345678901234567890.123456789]) |
| Output | StringColumn[1.100000000, -0.000000001, 12345678901234567890.123456789] |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(CAST(s AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS STRING)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(CAST(s::String AS Decimal(38, 9)) AS String)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Decimal(38, 9)>(CAST<String>(s AS Decimal(38, 9)) AS String NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
|        | s                                                   | Output                           |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
| Type   | String                                              | String NULL                      |
| Domain | {"-0.000000001"..="12345678901234567890.123456789"} | Unknown                          |
| Row 0  | '1.1'                                               | '1.100000000'                    |
| Row 1  | '-0.000000001'                                      | '-0.000000001'                   |
| Row 2  | '12345678901234567890.123456789'                    | '12345678901234567890.123456789' |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                                                                       |
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[1.1, -0.000000001, 12345678901234567890.123456789])                                                    |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: StringColumn[1.100000000, -0.000000001, 12345678901234567890.123456789], validity: [0b_____111] } |
+--------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(to_timestamp_tz('2024-01-02 03:04:05 +0800') AS STRING)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(to_timestamp_tz('2024-01-02 03:04:05 +0800') AS String)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<TimestampTz>(CAST<String>("2024-01-02 03:04:05 +0800" AS TimestampTz) AS String NULL)
optimized expr : "2024-01-02 03:04:05.000000 +0800"
output type    : String NULL
output domain  : {"2024-01-02 03:04:05.000000 +0800"..="2024-01-02 03:04:05.000000 +0800"}
output         : '2024-01-02 03:04:05.000000 +0800'


ast            : TRY_CAST(to_interval('1 day 2 hours') AS STRING)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(to_interval('1 day 2 hours') AS String)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Interval>(CAST<String>("1 day 2 hours" AS Interval) AS String NULL)
optimized expr : "1 day 2:00:00"
output type    : String NULL
output domain  : {"1 day 2:00:00"..="1 day 2:00:00"}
output         : '1 day 2:00:00'


ast            : TRY_CAST(to_bitmap('1,3') AS STRING)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(to_bitmap('1,3') AS String)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Bitmap>(CAST<String>("1,3" AS Bitmap) AS String NULL)
optimized expr : "1,3"
output type    : String NULL
output domain  : {"1,3"..="1,3"}
output         : '1,3'


ast            : TRY_CAST(s AS BITMAP)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(s::String AS Bitmap)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<String>(s AS Bitmap NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+-----------------+--------------------+
|        | s               | Output             |
+--------+-----------------+--------------------+
| Type   | String          | Bitmap NULL        |
| Domain | {"1,3"..="abc"} | Undefined ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | '1,3'           | '1,3'              |
| Row 1  | 'abc'           | NULL               |
+--------+-----------------+--------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                                                          |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[1,3, abc])                                                                                |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Bitmap([0x484201000201000000000000000300000000000000, 0x]), validity: [0b______01] } |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(parse_json(s) AS ARRAY(INT32))
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast to type Int32 while evaluating function `to_int32('"a"')` in expr `CAST(CAST(s AS Variant) AS Array(Int32))`



ast            : TRY_CAST(parse_json(s) AS ARRAY(INT32))
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(parse_json(s::String) AS Array(Int32))
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Variant>(CAST<String>(s AS Variant) AS Array(Int32 NULL) NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+---------------------+------------------------+
|        | s                   | Output                 |
+--------+---------------------+------------------------+
| Type   | String              | Array(Int32 NULL) NULL |
| Domain | {"1"..="{\"a\":1}"} | Unknown                |
| Row 0  | '[1,2]'             | [1, 2]                 |
| Row 1  | '1'                 | []                     |
| Row 2  | '{"a":1}'           | []                     |
| Row 3  | '["a"]'             | [NULL]                 |
+--------+---------------------+------------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                                                                                                                     |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[[1,2], 1, {"a":1}, ["a"]])                                                                                                                           |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: ArrayColumn { values: NullableColumn { column: Int32([1, 2, 0]), validity: [0b_____011] }, offsets: [0, 2, 2, 2, 3] }, validity: [0b____1111] } |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(parse_json(s) AS MAP(STRING, INT32))
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(parse_json(s::String) AS Map(String, Int32))
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Variant>(CAST<String>(s AS Variant) AS Map(String, Int32) NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+---------------------+-------------------------+
|        | s                   | Output                  |
+--------+---------------------+-------------------------+
| Type   | String              | Map(String, Int32) NULL |
| Domain | {"1"..="{\"a\":1}"} | Unknown                 |
| Row 0  | '[1,2]'             | {}                      |
| Row 1  | '1'                 | {}                      |
| Row 2  | '{"a":1}'           | {'a':1}                 |
| Row 3  | '["a"]'             | {}                      |
+--------+---------------------+-------------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                                                                                      |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[[1,2], 1, {"a":1}, ["a"]])                                                                                            |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: ArrayColumn { values: Tuple([StringColumn[a], Int32([1])]), offsets: [0, 0, 0, 1, 1] }, validity: [0b____1111] } |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Casts through an intermediate type

A cast without a function of its own converts through an intermediate type, and a row that fails in
either step is NULL for `TRY_CAST`.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


plan           : Date -> Int8: [Date -> Int64: to_int64(Date) :: Int64] then [Int64 -> Int8: to_int8(Int64) :: Int8]
plan           : Timestamp -> Float32: [Timestamp -> Int64: to_int64(Timestamp) :: Int64] then [Int64 -> Float32: to_float32(Int64) :: Float32]
plan           : UInt64 -> Date: [UInt64 -> Int64: to_int64(UInt64) :: Int64] then [Int64 -> Date: to_date(Int64) :: Date]
plan           : UInt8 -> Bitmap: [UInt8 -> UInt64: to_uint64(UInt8) :: UInt64] then [UInt64 -> Bitmap: to_bitmap(UInt64) :: Bitmap]
plan           : Decimal(10, 2) -> Boolean: [Decimal(10, 2) -> Float64: to_float64(Decimal(10, 2)) :: Float64] then [Float64 -> Boolean: to_boolean(Float64) :: Boolean]
plan           : Date NULL -> Int64 NULL: to_int64(Date NULL) :: Int64 NULL

error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(d AS INT8)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ number overflowed while evaluating function `to_int8(19724)` in expr `CAST(d AS Int8)`



ast            : TRY_CAST(d AS INT8)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(d::Date AS Int8)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Date>(d AS Int8 NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+--------------+---------------------+
|        | d            | Output              |
+--------+--------------+---------------------+
| Type   | Date         | Int8 NULL           |
| Domain | {-1..=19724} | {-1..=127} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | '1969-12-31' | -1                  |
| Row 1  | '1970-01-02' | 1                   |
| Row 2  | '2024-01-02' | NULL                |
+--------+--------------+---------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+
| d      | Column(Date([-1, 1, 19724]))                                        |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Int8([-1, 1, 0]), validity: [0b_____011] } |
+--------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : TRY_CAST(d AS UINT64)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(d::Date AS UInt64)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Date>(d AS UInt64 NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+--------------+----------------------+
|        | d            | Output               |
+--------+--------------+----------------------+
| Type   | Date         | UInt64 NULL          |
| Domain | {-1..=19724} | {0..=19724} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | '1969-12-31' | NULL                 |
| Row 1  | '1970-01-02' | 1                    |
| Row 2  | '2024-01-02' | 19724                |
+--------+--------------+----------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                     |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| d      | Column(Date([-1, 1, 19724]))                                             |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: UInt64([0, 1, 19724]), validity: [0b_____110] } |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+

checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Decimal(10, 2)>(CAST<Decimal(2, 1)>(-1.5_d64(2,1) AS Decimal(10, 2)) AS Boolean NULL)
optimized expr : true
output type    : Boolean NULL
output domain  : {TRUE}
output         : true


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NULL

A NULL converts to NULL. `CAST` to a type that is not nullable fails on a NULL, but only in a row
that the cast converts.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(n AS INT64)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `NULL` to type `Int64`, during run expr: `CAST(n AS Int64)`



ast            : TRY_CAST(n AS INT64)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(n::Int32 NULL AS Int64)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Int32 NULL>(n AS Int64 NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+------------------+------------------+
|        | n                | Output           |
+--------+------------------+------------------+
| Type   | Int32 NULL       | Int64 NULL       |
| Domain | {1..=1} ∪ {NULL} | {1..=1} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | 1                | 1                |
| Row 1  | NULL             | NULL             |
+--------+------------------+------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                     |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| n      | Column(NullableColumn { column: Int32([1, 0]), validity: [0b______01] }) |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Int64([1, 0]), validity: [0b______01] }         |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+


ast            : CAST(n AS INT64 NULL)
raw expr       : CAST(n::Int32 NULL AS Int64 NULL)
checked expr   : CAST<Int32 NULL>(n AS Int64 NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+------------------+------------------+
|        | n                | Output           |
+--------+------------------+------------------+
| Type   | Int32 NULL       | Int64 NULL       |
| Domain | {1..=1} ∪ {NULL} | {1..=1} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | 1                | 1                |
| Row 1  | NULL             | NULL             |
+--------+------------------+------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                     |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| n      | Column(NullableColumn { column: Int32([1, 0]), validity: [0b______01] }) |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Int64([1, 0]), validity: [0b______01] }         |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(NULL AS INT32)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `NULL` to type `Int32`, during run expr: `CAST(NULL AS Int32)`



ast            : TRY_CAST(NULL AS INT32)
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(NULL AS Int32)
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<NULL>(NULL AS Int32 NULL)
optimized expr : NULL
output type    : Int32 NULL
output domain  : {NULL}
output         : NULL


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | CAST(parse_json('null') AS INT32)
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ unable to cast type `Variant` to type `Int32`, result has null values, during run expr: `CAST(CAST('null' AS Variant) AS Int32)`



ast            : CAST(parse_json('null') AS INT32 NULL)
raw expr       : CAST(parse_json('null') AS Int32 NULL)
checked expr   : CAST<Variant>(CAST<String>("null" AS Variant) AS Int32 NULL)
optimized expr : NULL
output type    : Int32 NULL

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nested values

A nested value converts by its elements. For `TRY_CAST`, an element that fails is NULL, and the
other elements and rows are kept.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : TRY_CAST([n, -1, 2] AS ARRAY(UINT8))
raw expr       : TRY_CAST(array(n::Int64, -1, 2) AS Array(UInt8))
checked expr   : TRY_CAST<Array(Int64)>(array<T0=Int64><T0, T0, T0>(n, CAST<Int8>(-1_i8 AS Int64), CAST<UInt8>(2_u8 AS Int64)) AS Array(UInt8 NULL) NULL)
optimized expr : TRY_CAST<Array(Int64)>(array<T0=Int64><T0, T0, T0>(n, -1_i64, 2_i64) AS Array(UInt8 NULL) NULL)
evaluation:
+--------+------------+------------------------+
|        | n          | Output                 |
+--------+------------+------------------------+
| Type   | Int64      | Array(UInt8 NULL) NULL |
| Domain | {1..=1000} | [{0..=255} ∪ {NULL}]   |
| Row 0  | 1          | [1, NULL, 2]           |
| Row 1  | 1000       | [NULL, NULL, 2]        |
+--------+------------+------------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                                                                                                                                        |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| n      | Column(Int64([1, 1000]))                                                                                                                                                    |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: ArrayColumn { values: NullableColumn { column: UInt8([1, 0, 2, 0, 0, 2]), validity: [0b__100101] }, offsets: [0, 3, 6] }, validity: [0b______11] } |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Domains

The domain of a cast comes from the rule of each step. A `CAST` whose rows may fail has no domain,
so that folding does not skip the error; a `TRY_CAST` may be NULL only when a row may fail.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST(s AS DATE)
raw expr       : CAST(s::String AS Date)
checked expr   : CAST<String>(s AS Date)
evaluation:
+--------+----------------------------------------+--------------+
|        | s                                      | Output       |
+--------+----------------------------------------+--------------+
| Type   | String                                 | Date         |
| Domain | {"2022-01-02"..="2022-01-02 01:00:00"} | Unknown      |
| Row 0  | '2022-01-02'                           | '2022-01-02' |
| Row 1  | '2022-01-02 01:00:00'                  | '2022-01-02' |
+--------+----------------------------------------+--------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                  |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[2022-01-02, 2022-01-02 01:00:00]) |
| Output | Date([18994, 18994])                                  |
+--------+-------------------------------------------------------+


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Domain of a single value

A single value besides NULL converts exactly, by running the step that converts it.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Domain of maps

The entries of a map convert as the elements of an array do.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
try_to_x functions

`try_to_x` is an ordinary function that converts as its own overloads do, not a cast. The SQL binder
keeps a value of the own type of some of them, see the type check tests of the SQL planner.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : try_to_int8(s)
raw expr       : try_to_int8(s::String)
checked expr   : try_to_int8<String>(s)
evaluation:
+--------+---------------+-----------------------+
|        | s             | Output                |
+--------+---------------+-----------------------+
| Type   | String        | Int8 NULL             |
| Domain | {"1"..="abc"} | {-128..=127} ∪ {NULL} |
| Row 0  | '1'           | 1                     |
| Row 1  | 'abc'         | NULL                  |
+--------+---------------+-----------------------+
evaluation (internal):
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Column | Data                                                            |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| s      | Column(StringColumn[1, abc])                                    |
| Output | NullableColumn { column: Int8([1, 0]), validity: [0b______01] } |
+--------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
